appliesWhen.semanticAnchor: mapping and hydrating ShardKey properties with MapSqlShardKeyAttribute, MapPgShardKeyAttribute, or MapShardKeyAttribute and configuring shardParameterName for foreign-shard keys or server-side shard verification

fields.body: When hydrating a `[MapSqlShardKey]` or `[MapPgShardKey]` property on a model, omit the `shardParameterName` constructor argument when the `ShardId` originates from the executing shard connection itself—the `Mapper` automatically supplies the connection's `shardId`. Specify a `shardParameterName` column or parameter name only when reading a foreign-shard reference stored in the row or when passing the current `shardId` into a SQL command for server-side shard verification.
fields.title: ShardKey hydration and shardParameterName usage
